question: What is the main cause of the body changes that happen during pregnancy?

options.C: More physical activity by the mother

explanation: Hormones produced by the placenta and corpus luteum drive the widespread body changes seen throughout pregnancy. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T003#GNS226_U2_T003_h1)

question: Why is it important for nurses to know the normal body changes during pregnancy?

options.A: To calculate the exact expected date of delivery
options.B: To avoid doing routine laboratory tests
options.C: To tell normal changes apart from real health problems
options.D: To completely stop early pregnancy discomforts

explanation: Many normal changes can look like signs of illness, so nurses need good clinical skills during antenatal checks to spot the difference. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T003#GNS226_U2_T003_h1)

question: What causes physiological anemia in pregnant women?

options.A: Fast breakdown of red blood cells in the spleen
options.B: Blood fluid volume increases faster than red blood cells
options.C: A shortage of iron in all diets
options.D: Poor iron absorption in the gut

explanation: Anemia happens because the liquid part of blood increases much faster than the total number of red blood cells, diluting them. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T003#GNS226_U2_T003_h2)

question: A pregnant woman at 32 weeks feels dizzy when lying flat on her back. What is the reason?

options.A: Low blood pressure from standing up too fast
options.B: Pressure on major blood vessels from the heavy uterus
options.C: Sudden tightening of brain blood vessels
options.D: Low blood sugar from high baby demands

explanation: The heavy uterus presses on the main vena cava vein, which lowers blood flow back to the heart when lying flat. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T003#GNS226_U2_T003_h2)

question: Which breathing measurement increases a lot during pregnancy?
explanation: Progesterone makes breathing deeper, which greatly increases the amount of air moved with each breath. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T003#GNS226_U2_T003_h3)

question: What is the main reason pregnant women breathe faster and deeper?

options.A: To help move carbon dioxide away from the baby
options.B: To fix severe acid buildup in the mother's blood
options.C: To store extra oxygen for delivery
options.D: To cool down the body during hard work

explanation: Having lower carbon dioxide levels in the mother's blood creates a gradient that pulls carbon dioxide across the placenta from the baby. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T003#GNS226_U2_T003_h3)

question: What happens to the kidney filtration rate during pregnancy?

options.A: It drops because the heart pumps less blood
options.B: It changes wildly based on how much water is drunk
options.C: It increases by up to 50 percent
options.D: It stays completely the same as before

explanation: Better blood flow to the kidneys causes a big jump in how much waste they filter throughout pregnancy. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T003#GNS226_U2_T003_h4)

question: Why are pregnant women more likely to get kidney infections (pyelonephritis)?

options.A: High sugar in urine helps bacteria grow
options.B: Progesterone relaxes the tubes from the kidneys, slowing urine flow
options.C: Kidney blood flow drops a lot late in pregnancy
options.D: The bladder lining becomes weak and bleeds easily

explanation: Smooth muscle relaxation slows down urine passing through the ureters, giving bacteria an easy path to the kidneys. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T003#GNS226_U2_T003_h4)

question: Which tummy problem is directly caused by progesterone relaxing smooth muscles?
explanation: Relaxation of the valve at the bottom of the food pipe and slower gut movement lead to acid reflux and constipation. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T003#GNS226_U2_T003_h5)

question: A woman in her first trimester has ongoing morning sickness. Which hormone is a main cause?
explanation: Rising levels of human chorionic gonadotropin are closely linked to nausea and vomiting in early pregnancy. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T003#GNS226_U2_T003_h5)

question: What is the main job of human placental lactogen in the body's metabolism?

options.A: Making the mother's body resist insulin to leave sugar for the baby
options.B: Starting breast milk production before birth
options.C: Slowing down thyroid hormones to save energy
options.D: Lowering blood sugar by pushing it into cells fast

explanation: Human placental lactogen changes how the mother processes food so that enough glucose remains free to cross over to the baby. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T003#GNS226_U2_T003_h6)

question: Why do the thyroid glands often look a bit bigger during a normal pregnancy?

options.A: Not getting enough iodine causes a permanent swelling
options.B: Immune cells attack the gland and make it swell
options.C: The gland grows due to higher metabolic needs and hormones
options.D: Nearby lymph nodes press on it and make it look larger

explanation: Gland tissue grows to keep up with higher hormone signals and faster body clearance rates. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T003#GNS226_U2_T003_h6)

question: Which hormone is mainly responsible for loose joints during pregnancy?
explanation: Relaxin softens collagen and pelvic ligaments, making joints more flexible to help the baby pass through during birth. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T003#GNS226_U2_T003_h7)

question: A pregnant woman complains of lower back pain in her third trimester. What is the main physical cause?

options.A: The baby's head pressing directly on the sciatic nerve
options.B: The body's center of gravity shifting forward, causing an arched back
options.C: Calcium being pulled out of the spine bones
options.D: Worn-out spinal discs caused by hormones

explanation: The growing uterus pulls the body forward, making the lower back curve more and straining the back muscles. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T003#GNS226_U2_T003_h7)

question: Which symptom should a pregnant woman report right away as a warning sign?

options.A: Mild swelling in the feet and ankles
options.B: Occasional mild heartburn after eating a big meal
options.D: Getting up often to pee at night

explanation: Headaches and vision changes can be warning signs of severe pre-eclampsia that need quick medical attention. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T003#GNS226_U2_T003_h8)

question: What is an important goal when teaching pregnant women at antenatal clinics?

options.A: Making them follow strict diets so they do not gain too much weight
options.B: Trying to get rid of all normal minor complaints completely
options.C: Telling them not to do any exercise to keep the pregnancy safe
options.D: Teaching them how to tell normal discomforts apart from danger signs

explanation: Giving women the right information helps them report dangerous issues early while easing worries about normal body changes. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T003#GNS226_U2_T003_h8)
